item.title: WVDOH warns potholes likely with warmer temperatures
item.description: According to a news release the WVDOH issued Monday, the division is less able to deal with potholes during the winter months, when asphalt plants are shut down for annual maintenance.

item.title: Proposed West Virginia bill would provide 'scholarships' for daycare employees
item.description: West Virginia currently sits at 50th in the nation in workforce participation, and with the ongoing childcare crisis throughout the state, a new bill on the floor of the West Virginia Legislature would combat both issues.

item.title: UHC announces $48 million project that includes new surgery center
item.description: WVU Medicine United Hospital Center has announced a $48 million project at its campus, which is set to include a new outpatient surgery center.

item.title: How the Preston County Board of Education is handling all these snow days
item.description: It's been a snowy start to 2026, and the inclement weather has caused many schools throughout north central West Virginia to close or operate on delays so far this winter, including Preston County.

item.title: Hulu announces Skylar Neese docuseries: How to watch
item.description: It's been nearly 15 years since the murder of Morgantown girl Skylar Neese, and now, the murder case that gripped north central West Virginia will be revisited in a three-part documentary series on Hulu.

item.title: Belington gets refueled: Go Mart purchases former Sheetz site
item.description: The City of Belington will have a gas station again as officials with Go Mart have confirmed for 12 News that they have purchased the site of the former Sheetz.

item.title: Morgantown police find drum magazine after shots fired compaint, man charged
item.description: A man has been charged after allegedly firing a pistol multiple times outside of a residence in Morgantown and later admitted to "drinking."

item.title: Webster County woman charged after kids found in home with 'mounds' of trash, diapers: WVSP
item.description: A woman has been charged after allegedly telling juveniles to hide from law enforcement in a Webster County home that troopers say was full of trash with feces throughout.

item.title: 2 indicted for attempted murder in Marion County
item.description: The Marion County Grand Jury handed up its list of indictments for the February 2026 term on Monday, with two men accused of attempted murder topping the list.

item.title: DETAILS: Missing Preston County man found dead in Maryland
item.description: The West Virginia State Police has released more information regarding the disappearance of Willard A. DeWitt, the subject of a recently-cancelled Silver Alert, including that he has been found dead.
